title: Fire-resistant penetrations and joints.
officialText:
Special inspections for through-penetrations, membrane penetration firestops, fire-
resistant joint systems, and perimeter fire barrier systems that are tested and listed in accordance with Sections 713.4.1.1.2, 713.4.1.2,
714.3 and 714.4 shall comply with Sections 1704.27.1 and 1704.27.2.
